property_summary: After buyShares when totalSupply > 0, the resulting base target equals the original base target plus a proportional increase based on mint ratio.
After buyShares when totalSupply > 0 and both reserves are positive, the new base target divided by the new quote target equals the base balance divided by the quote balance.
After buyShares, the product of _BASE_TARGET_ and _QUOTE_RESERVE_ equals the product of _QUOTE_TARGET_ and _BASE_RESERVE_.

After any call to adjustMtFeeRate, the state variables BASE_TARGET and QUOTE_TARGET must equal the reserves when RState is ONE; the buggy correctRState fails to set BASE_TARGET, violating this invariant.

After adjustMtFeeRate is called, the sum of BASE_TARGET and QUOTE_TARGET must always be at least the sum of BASE_RESERVE and QUOTE_RESERVE; the buggy correctRState fails to reset BASE_TARGET when transitioning to ONE, potentially making the target sum smaller than the reserve sum.

After adjustMtFeeRate, if RState is BELOW_ONE and base reserve drops below base target, correctRState should transition to ONE and set BASE_TARGET to BASE_RESERVE; the bug omits this assignment, so BASE_TARGET can remain larger than the reserve.
